bias: mean_bootstrap_derivative_minus_original; corrected_center=2*original-mean_bootstrap; centered_bootstrap_t_maxima; no claim this removes basis approximation bias
uncorrected_band: max_abs((theta_star-theta)/model_se_star); original center and original model SE
corrected_band: max_abs((theta_star-mean_theta_star)/model_se_star); corrected center and original model SE
bootstrap_failure_policy: no retries; require >=98 percent valid refits; all failures recorded; incomplete outer fit counts as noncoverage
generator: synthetic_derivative_data in frozen R/derivative_calibration.R; intercept SD .5; innovation SD .3; AR .6; random dropout 12:20; missing .15
development_gate: candidate coverage>=.90 and valid outer fits>=.98 in EVERY noninformative cell; 20 reps is screening only
validation_gate: candidate coverage>=.93 and Wilson95_lower>=.90 and valid outer fits>=.99 in EVERY noninformative cell
policy: only prespecified candidate can advance; failed gate stops this version; independent validation has unchanged code and parameters; real analysis only after independent gate and new config
